name: facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/stretch_continual/stretch_continual/envs/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.create_StretchCollectDemoEnv: create a StretchCollectDemoEnv instance to collect robot demos with Xbox controller callbacks and recording
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.run_step_loop: run the step loop on a StretchCollectDemoEnv to collect observations and actions during an episode
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.reset_environment: reset the StretchCollectDemoEnv to initialize the current timestep and get the first observation
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.review_start_button_callback: review the _start_button_callback method that toggles episode recording start and stop states
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.refactor_publish_to_ros: refactor the _publish_to_ros method to publish key frame poses as ROS TransformStamped messages

facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.load_h5_trajectories: load all h5 trajectory files from a directory into an aggregated h5 file with ExternalLink support
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.select_random_trajectory: randomly select a trajectory from h5 files in a directory with retry logic and caching
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.compute_gripper_forward_kinematics: compute the end-effector position and rotation from the robot model and current joint pose
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.compute_gripper_inverse_kinematics: compute inverse kinematics for the gripper with wrist roll normalization to prevent full rotations
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.construct_observation: construct a combined observation dict with image, depth, pose, and camera info for the Stretch robot environment

facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.create_StretchLiveEnv: create a StretchLiveEnv instance with a demo directory and optional camera info in state
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.run_StretchLiveEnv_reset: run the reset method on StretchLiveEnv to load a random trajectory and position the robot
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.run_StretchLiveEnv_step: run a step action on StretchLiveEnv to execute predicted robot actions with IK and interpolation
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.review_StretchLiveEnv_interpolate: review the _interpolate_robot_to_in_joint_space method for naive joint space interpolation logic
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.refactor_StretchLiveEnv_exec_tol: refactor the StretchLiveEnv exec_tol array to adjust execution tolerance thresholds per joint dimension

facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.create_offline_demo_env: create a StretchOfflineDemoEnv instance with a demo directory and camera info settings
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.reset_environment_trajectory: reset the offline demo environment to randomly select a new trajectory from the demo directory
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.step_through_trajectory: step through the current demo trajectory and return the next observation and done flag
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.get_observation_for_timestep: get the observation for a specific timestep including RGB, depth, and joint state data
facebookresearch_home-robot/projects/str.construct_camera_data_from_demo: construct color and depth camera info plus camera pose from a demo trajectory at a timestep
